picks.headline: Roborock shows off a series of new vacuums at IFA 2026
picks.excerpt: Roborock unveiled several new robot vacuums, a robotic mower and a pool cleaner at IFA 2026, leaning on AI vision to recognize obstacles and adapt cleaning routes. The lineup shows how far on-device perception has moved into ordinary home appliances.
picks.rationale: IFA 2026 로봇청소기 신제품군 발표 — 온디바이스 AI 비전이 가정용 가전으로 내려온 사례.

picks.headline: Circular just announced two new smart rings at IFA 2026: I sat down with their CEO to find out more
picks.excerpt: Circular revealed the Ring 3 in Slim and Pro versions, slimmer than the Ring 2 and adding NFC contactless payments plus haptic alerts for alarms and medication. The company frames the AI health coaching as the reason to keep it on your finger.
picks.rationale: 실제 출시되는 스마트링 2종 + NFC 결제/햅틱 추가, AI 헬스 코칭이 착용 이유로 제시됨.

picks.headline: Sept. 2026 Android Drop: Find Hub 'Remembered' list, Motion Assist, & Keep in Google Messages
picks.excerpt: Google's September Android Drop lets Gemini remember where you physically put objects and adds Guided Vision, which narrates what the camera sees for low-vision users. Motion Assist on Android 17+ overlays moving bubbles to reduce car sickness.
picks.rationale: 내일 당장 폰에서 쓰는 기능 변화 — Gemini 물건 위치 기억, Guided Vision, Motion Assist.

picks.headline: Reolink Debuts OMVI 2i Ultra, Home Hub 2, and TrackFlex WiFi at IFA 2026
picks.excerpt: Reolink expanded its security camera line at IFA 2026 with the OMVI 2i Ultra and a second-generation Home Hub, pushing AI subject detection and local processing deeper into the camera itself.
picks.rationale: 보안 카메라 내부로 AI 피사체 인식과 로컬 처리를 밀어 넣은 실제 신제품 라인.

picks.headline: IFA 2026 'Best in Show' awards: our 25 favorite reveals at the Berlin tech expo
picks.excerpt: TechRadar picks 25 standouts from IFA 2026, from somersaulting robots to exoskeletons and modular solar batteries. The through-line is AI moving out of apps and into physical objects.
picks.rationale: IFA 2026 전체 지형 요약 — AI가 앱에서 나와 물리적 사물로 옮겨간 25개 사례.
